This role is vital in ensuring the seamless operation of internal systems and providing exceptional support to colleagues across the organization. As an IT Support Engineer, you will be responsible for managing day-to-day IT support requests, troubleshooting technical issues, and maintaining IT infrastructure. The position offers an excellent opportunity to work within a collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional development. You will play a key role in supporting Microsoft 365 applications, internal systems, and hardware, ensuring that the organization’s technology functions efficiently and securely. The role also involves supporting new technology implementations, assisting with office projects, and contributing to the ongoing improvement of IT services. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a combination of technical expertise, strong communication skills, and a customer-focused approach. Relevant qualifications and experience are essential for success in this role. Candidates should have at least three years of hands-on IT support experience, demonstrating proficiency in managing helpdesk tickets, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and supporting enterprise applications. Knowledge of Active Directory administration, Windows 11, and Microsoft 365 support is required. Additionally, experience supporting laptops, monitors, docks, and video conferencing equipment is highly desirable. Strong troubleshooting skills, customer service orientation, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment are critical. Certifications such as Microsoft or CompTIA qualifications, along with familiarity with Azure, Azure AD, and ITIL frameworks, are considered advantageous. Responsibilities Manage helpdesk tickets efficiently, ensuring timely resolution of IT issues across the organization. Provide support for laptops, monitors, docks, and meeting room equipment to ensure optimal functionality. Assist users with corporate iPhones, personal devices, and internal applications, ensuring seamless connectivity and usability. Troubleshoot network and connectivity issues, maintaining stable and secure network environments. Manage user accounts for new starters and leavers, including onboarding and offboarding procedures. Maintain accurate IT asset records and documentation for hardware, software, and licenses. Deliver basic IT inductions and training for new employees to facilitate smooth onboarding. Support the management of Teams, Exchange Online groups, and distribution lists to ensure effective communication channels. Assist with IT equipment rollouts, office relocations, and other technical projects to support business operations. Provide ongoing support for Microsoft 365 applications and internal systems, ensuring high availability and performance. Help maintain the helpdesk system, automate processes, and support phishing awareness initiatives to enhance security posture. Embrace new technologies, including automation tools and artificial intelligence, to improve service delivery and operational efficiency. Benefits The role offers a friendly and supportive working environment that fosters professional growth and development. Employees benefit from a good work/life balance, with flexible hybrid working arrangements that accommodate individual needs. The organization provides opportunities for continuous learning, including access to training and certifications, to enhance technical skills and career progression. Additionally, employees enjoy competitive compensation packages, comprehensive health benefits, and a collaborative culture that values innovation and teamwork. The company also promotes a positive and inclusive workplace where diversity is celebrated, and every employee’s contribution is recognized and valued. Equal Opportunity Robert Half is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to serve our clients and supports a positive working environment for all employees. We encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds to apply and look forward to welcoming individuals who can contribute to our culture of innovation and excellence.

review_candidates.title: Core Infrastructure Engineer 2
review_candidates.description: Job Description As a Software Engineer on the Virtual Networking Gateways team, you will design, build, maintain, and test automation for provisioning, deploying, managing, and operating OCI virtual networking fleets. You will participate directly in fleet operations and change management. You will work primarily in Terraform and Python, contributing to our deployment pipelines. You will improve reliability by writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests as well as by creating and maintaining operational runbooks. You will manage your assigned work, maintain clear status in the team’s work-tracking system, and triage overlapping requests from partner service teams. This role requires the judgment to assess requests in the context of fleet scale, available capacity, operational risk, and cost; recognize when a request is disproportionate to the existing environment; and engage partner teams directly to clarify requirements and develop feasible approaches, escalating when appropriate. Candidates should have a foundational understanding of virtual networking and be comfortable owning well-scoped tasks with limited day-to-day direction. Familiarity with C++, experience supporting infrastructure in a hyperscale cloud environment, and experience building infrastructure or tooling for automated testing are beneficial but not required. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: –Assist in the implementation of components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling under the guidance of senior engineers. –Optimize code segments and/or systems for large-scale data processing with oversight from senior engineers. –Implement scalability requirements for assigned components. –Learn about the use of data plane platforms for large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. –Execute performance and load testing, with guidance. System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: –Collaborate with the team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by learning about redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. –Learn about recovery oriented computing principles and assist in applying them to component designs. –Configure and test retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability, with guidance System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: –Implement testing and alarming configurations to detect issues/failures. –Support efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures, under guidance. –Help build dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: –Implement functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. –Implement test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness, under guidance. –Help implement basic data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: –Assist in diagnosing and debugging issues in system components to support ongoing operation, under supervision. –Follow protocols to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. –Run basic automation scripts and tooling to troubleshoot operational issues. –Participate in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. Compliance & Security: –Assist in implementing basic security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. –Assist in the execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, under supervision. –Support the creation and updating of documentation to ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations. Automation & Change Management: –Assist in maintaining basic automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)). –Adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, under guidance Core Responsibilities Planning & Execution: –Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. –Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance Collaboration & Partnership: –Collaborate within the team to better understand expectations and achieve shared objectives. –Leverage a foundational understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build partnerships with limited guidance. –Actively listen and ask questions to enhance collaboration. –Build a basic understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs with guidance. Problem Solving: –Identify and address issues, escalating problems to senior staff as needed in accordance with standard procedures. –Compile and review data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Continuous Learning: –Seek opportunities to gain knowledge and learn new skills and/or tools aligned with industry trends and best practices. –Utilize feedback and training to improve skills. –Participate in a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing. Continuous Improvement: –Implement updates to processes, protocols, and workflows to increase efficiency and effectiveness as directed, with some guidance. –Contribute to ideation for future process improvements. Qualifications Disclaimer: Certain U.S. based or U.S. customer or client-facing roles may be required to comply with applicable requirements, such as immunization/occupational health mandates, and/or drug testing requirements. Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only US: Hiring Range in USD from: $70,000 - $166,100 per year. May be eligible for bonus and equity. Oracle maintains broad salary ranges for its roles in order to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect Oracle's differing products, industries and lines of business. Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity. Oracle US offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion Short term disability and long term disability Life insurance and AD&D Supplemental life insurance (Employee/Spouse/Child) Health care and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts Pre-tax commuter and parking benefits 401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company match Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation. 11 paid holidays Paid sick leave: 72 hours of paid sick leave upon date of hire. Refreshes each calendar year. Unused balance will carry over each year up to a maximum cap of 112 hours. Paid parental leave Adoption assistance Employee Stock Purchase Plan Financial planning and group legal Voluntary benefits including auto, homeowner and pet insurance The role will generally accept applications for at least three calendar days from the posting date or as long as the job remains posted. Career Level - IC2 About Us Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. review_candidates.title: Verpleegkundige Justus Lipsius
review_candidates.description: Onderneming emeis is een van de grootste zorgverleners in België. Goede zorg is teamwork, dus staan we altijd klaar om elkaar te helpen en van elkaar te leren. De naam emeis , geïnspireerd door het Oud-Griekse ‘wij’, weerspiegelt de hechte band met onze bewoners, hun families en de samenleving als geheel. In onze woonzorgcentra en assistentiewoningen is het goed leven én werken. Functie Als Verpleegkundige bij emeis help je bewoners om zo zelfstandig en comfortabel mogelijk te leven. Een warme, huiselijke sfeer waarin iedereen zich goed voelt, daar doe jij het voor! Jij maakt het graag persoonlijk, dus betrek je ook de families van de bewoners bij de zorg. Profiel We zoeken een enthousiaste Verpleegkundige met een hart voor ouderen . Iemand die graag bijleert, helemaal tot leven komt in een multidisciplinaire omgeving en voor wie de kwaliteit van de zorg primeert. Vink je het alvast het volgende af? Je hebt een erkend diploma Verpleegkunde; Je hebt een geldig visum van de FOD Volksgezondheid; Je spreekt vlot Nederlands; Je kunt overweg met zorgsoftware – of je hebt hier interesse in. Heb je na het lezen van deze tekst zin om meer te weten? Misschien bezit je daarnaast over persoonlijke superpowers die het verschil kunnen maken? Laat dan zeker van je horen. Aanbod Emotionele momenten, veel verantwoordelijkheid, ... werken als Verpleegkundige is pittig – dat moeten we jou niet vertellen. Maar jouw werk is ook waardevol en bijzonder belangrijk. Daarom doen we ons best om jou te ondersteunen, zodat jij alles kunt geven voor de bewoners en dicht bij jezelf kan blijven. Bij ons blijft je werk boeiend en gevarieerd, en je staat er nooit alleen voor. Je komt terecht in een gezellig team waar we hard werken maar ook graag eens lachen. Jij verdient meer dan alleen een professionele werkplek. Een ruime ontspanningsruimte, een groene omgeving, een plek waar je je snel goed zal voelen! Maar dat is niet alles: Werkzekerheid en aandacht voor jouw welzijn: een vast contract (voltijds) met flexibele uren die passen bij jouw behoeften; Correcte verloning: volgens IFIC 14/14b met behoud van anciënniteit (14: tussen 3.379 en 5.339€ bruto / 14b: 3.124 en 4.755€ bruto); Extraatjes die tellen: maaltijdcheques, woon-werkvergoeding, hospitalisatieverzekering, eindejaarspremie, attractiviteitspremie en kortingen via Benefits@Work; Aandacht voor jouw gezin: kinderopvang tijdens de schoolvakanties; Jezelf ontwikkelen: interne opleidingen en groeikansen; Waardering voor jouw inbreng: een premie van 750 euro als een kennis die jij aanbeveelt, wordt aangenomen. Talen emeis zoekt een Verpleegkundige voor woonzorgcentrum Justus Lipsius in Overijse. Wil jij werken in een hecht team waar je écht de tijd en middelen krijgt om goede zorg te bieden? Reik dan zeker naar ons uit want wij maken graag plaats voor jou!

Highly numerate with a degree in a quantitative field; a postgraduate qualification or relevant professional designation would be helpful. 2570022

The role involves designing, developing, and deploying robotics systems with a focus on scalable autonomy and real-time control. Candidates will collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate hardware and software solutions for next-generation robotic platforms. Key Responsibilities: • Design and implement control algorithms for robotic systems, including kinematics, dynamics, and path planning. • Develop and maintain software for robot perception, localization, and mapping using sensor fusion techniques. • Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate sensors, actuators, and embedded systems into functional robotic prototypes. • Optimize robotic performance for efficiency, reliability, and safety in dynamic environments. • Document technical specifications, test results, and deployment procedures for internal and external stakeholders. Required Skills & Qualifications: • Proficiency in robotics frameworks such as ROS, ROS 2, or similar platforms. • Strong programming skills in C++, Python, or other relevant languages for robotics applications. • Experience with real-time control systems, embedded software, and hardware-in-the-loop testing. • Knowledge of computer vision, SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping), or sensor fusion techniques. • Familiarity with simulation tools like Gazebo, CoppeliaSim, or NVIDIA Isaac Sim is required. • Experience with robotic operating systems, middleware, and communication protocols (e.g., CAN, Ethernet, UDP). • Ability to design and analyze algorithms for motion planning, obstacle avoidance, and task execution. • Experience with version control systems such as Git and collaborative software development workflows. • Understanding of machine learning techniques for robotics, including reinforcement learning or imitation learning. • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex robotic systems. More About the Opportunity: This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Information Services industry, contributing to the development of autonomous robotic systems for industrial and commercial applications. The position involves high-impact work with cutting-edge technology and the chance to shape the future of robotics in a fast-evolving field. Equal Opportunity Employer: We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. Apply Now!

review_candidates.title: Intelligence Analyst
review_candidates.description: Working within the Rights & Revenue Protection (RRP) team, the Intelligence Analyst will support investigations relating to the protection of Sportradar's intellectual property and revenue recovery activities across Europe and North America. The role focuses on identifying and assessing threats to Sportradar's content, data and commercial interests, including unauthorised data usage, piracy and intellectual property infringement. Using a range of open-source, cyber and commercial data sources, the analyst will deliver intelligence that supports enforcement activity, commercial outcomes and strategic decision-making. The position requires a motivated intelligence professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and supports stakeholders across the wider Sportradar Group. THE CHALLENGE Conduct intelligence investigations using an all-source approach across rights protection, enforcement and revenue recovery matters. Collect, analyse and evaluate intelligence from open-source, cyber and commercial sources. Conduct OSINT and CYBINT/DNINT investigations to produce actionable intelligence and recommendations. Identify and investigate unauthorised use of Sportradar data, content and intellectual property. Develop and maintain intelligence holdings relating to organisations, individuals and platforms operating across Europe and North America. Monitor emerging risks and trends relevant to intellectual property protection, piracy, sports betting and revenue recovery. Produce intelligence reports, analytical assessments and stakeholder briefings. Support enforcement and commercial recovery initiatives through intelligence development and research. Work closely across multiple Sportradar functions and departments to protect and enhance Sportradar business operations, including internal and external training and education on sports integrity. About You 2+ years' experience in intelligence, investigations, law enforcement, journalism, cyber security, financial crime, fraud, due diligence or a related analytical field. Experience conducting analytical investigations and producing intelligence-led outputs. Demonstrable expertise in OSINT, HUMINT, CYBINT/DNINT or comparable intelligence methodologies. Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to collect, evaluate and interpret information from multiple sources and produce actionable intelligence. Knowledge of online ecosystems, digital platforms and investigative research techniques. Awareness of data protection legislation and associated implications. High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professionalism. Ability to manage changing priorities and work effectively under pressure and to tight deadlines. Fluency in English essential, professional working proficiency in French or another living language strongly preferred. Advantageous Experience using intelligence analysis tools such as i2 Analyst's Notebook, Maltego or similar. Knowledge of the international sports betting, gaming, media or anti-piracy landscapes. Professional networks or regional knowledge across Europe and/or North America. Experience conducting investigations relating to intellectual property infringement, brand protection, digital piracy or revenue recovery. Understanding of corporate structures, beneficial ownership research and due diligence methodologies. Experience working with commercial intelligence databases and specialist investigative tools. Relevant intelligence, investigation or analytical certifications. Our Offer A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. Our Recruitment Process Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Hiring Team Interview : Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Assessment : Investigative task to showcase your technical skills. Final Steps : Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer!

review_candidates.title: Head of Customer Due Diligence
review_candidates.description: Why Join DAZN Bet? At DAZN Bet, we're creating a betting experience built around the sports fan, combining DAZN's world-class sports content, audience and technology with an exciting Sportsbook and Gaming proposition. As we continue to grow across regulated markets, having a scalable and effective approach to Customer Due Diligence is critical to protecting our customers, our licences and our business. We're looking for an experienced Head of Customer Due Diligence (CDD) to lead our global CDD operation, bringing together KYC, Enhanced Due Diligence and ongoing monitoring into one high-performing function. This is a senior operational leadership role with the opportunity to shape how DAZN Bet manages customer risk across its licensed markets while building the processes, technology and teams needed to support our future growth. The Role As Head of Customer Due Diligence , you'll have operational ownership of DAZN Bet's CDD function across all licensed markets, covering KYC, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Source of Funds/Source of Wealth and ongoing customer monitoring . Reporting to the Director of Operations , you'll lead a geographically distributed team and be responsible for ensuring due diligence activity is delivered accurately, efficiently and within agreed service levels. Operating as a first-line function , you'll work closely with the Head of AML & MLRO, Safer Gambling, Payments, Compliance, Legal and Product teams to ensure DAZN Bet maintains a joined-up approach to customer risk and financial crime prevention. You'll also lead the continued harmonisation and development of our CDD operation, using technology, automation and AI to improve efficiency, consistency and scalability as DAZN Bet enters new markets. What You’ll Be Doing Lead the end-to-end CDD operation across DAZN Bet's licensed markets , ensuring KYC, EDD, Source of Funds/Wealth and ongoing monitoring activity is completed accurately and within agreed SLAs. Lead and develop a geographically distributed CDD team, creating a high-performance culture focused on quality, accountability, customer experience and continuous improvement. Drive the harmonisation of KYC and CDD/EDD operations into a consistent global framework, identifying opportunities to simplify processes and improve decision-making. Ensure all CDD activity meets applicable AML legislation, licence conditions, internal policies and DAZN Bet's risk appetite across each regulated market. Own CDD Management Information and performance reporting, providing clear visibility of volumes, SLA performance, quality, capacity and emerging customer risk trends. Partner with Product and Technology teams to develop CDD tooling and introduce automation and Artificial Intelligence that improves operational efficiency, accuracy and scalability. Ensure the CDD operating model, processes and resources are capable of supporting DAZN Bet's expansion into new markets, contributing to regulatory and operational readiness ahead of launch. Work closely with AML, Safer Gambling, Payments, Compliance and Legal teams, representing CDD within governance forums and supporting regulatory queries and reviews. Manage CDD technology and third-party vendor relationships, ensuring service levels, capabilities and tooling continue to meet DAZN Bet's operational and regulatory requirements. What You’ll Bring Significant experience in a senior CDD, KYC, EDD or AML Operations leadership role within online betting and gaming, financial services or another highly regulated environment. Strong knowledge of CDD, KYC, EDD, Source of Funds/Wealth and ongoing monitoring frameworks, with experience applying these requirements operationally. Good understanding of AML legislation and regulatory expectations across multiple regulated markets, ideally including the UK, Ireland, Canada and European jurisdictions . Proven experience leading and developing geographically distributed operational teams, ideally managing teams of 8+ within a high-volume environment. Experience operating within a Three Lines of Defence model , with a strong understanding of the responsibilities and relationship between first and second-line functions. Strong operational management capability, including MI reporting, SLA management, capacity planning, quality assurance and performance management. A track record of delivering operational transformation, including process harmonisation, automation, technology improvements and scalable operating models. Experience managing CDD/KYC technology and third-party vendors, with confidence using Artificial Intelligence and data to improve operational and analytical performance. Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, work with regulators and lead teams successfully through change.

review_candidates.title: E-commerce & Growth Manager
review_candidates.description: Muromur Ieškome žmogaus, kuris padėtų Muromur nuo pirmųjų pardavimų išauginti į stiprų tarptautinį DTC prekės ženklą. Muromur – naujas premium lifestyle ir sleepwear ženklas, netrukus pristatantis pirmąją kolekciją. Kūrybinę kryptį, produktą ir gamybą jau turime. Šiuo metu ieškome žmogaus, kuris būtų atsakingas už Muromur e-commerce krypties kūrimą, komercinių rezultatų augimą ir ilgalaikės augimo sistemos vystymą. Tai nėra klasikinė marketingo ar e-shop administravimo pozicija. Ieškome žmogaus, kuris geba matyti visą DTC verslo grandinę – nuo klientų pritraukimo ir konversijos iki CRM, pakartotinių pirkimų ir pelningo pardavimų augimo – ir pats aktyviai prisideda prie jos kūrimo. Žmogaus, kuris vienodai natūraliai galvoja apie revenue, CR, AOV, CAC, retention ir produkto potencialą, geba pats imtis veiksmų ir ilgainiui nori augti į Head of E-commerce / Commercial Lead rolę. Ką valdysi? Tavo pagrindinis tikslas – sukurti ir auginti Muromur DTC komercinę sistemą. Būsi atsakingas(-a) už: e-commerce ir augimo strategijos kūrimą bei įgyvendinimą; produktų, kapsulių ir naujų rinkų go-to-market planavimą; augimo kanalų ir marketingo kampanijų planavimą, prioritetų nustatymą ir rezultatų vertinimą; Shopify parduotuvės komercinį rezultatą, merchandising ir nuolatinį optimizavimą; customer journey, conversion rate ir kitų e-commerce augimo svertų gerinimą; CRM / email marketing strategiją, lifecycle komunikaciją ir retention; performance marketing strategiją, kanalų efektyvumo vertinimą ir partnerių koordinavimą; pardavimų, CR, AOV, CAC, MER/ROAS, retention, LTV ir contribution rodiklių analizę; performance creative poreikio ir testavimo krypčių formulavimą kartu su kūrybine komanda; produktų rezultatų analizę – hero SKU, spalvas, dydžius, restock poreikį ir komercines įžvalgas kitoms kolekcijoms; naujų rinkų testavimą ir plėtros galimybių vertinimą. review_candidates.title: Declarant
review_candidates.description: Chceš proniknout do světa cel a mezinárodní logistiky? Staň se součástí našeho importního týmu a rozvíjej se v oboru, který má budoucnost. Aktuálně rozšiřujeme tým celních referentů a hledáme posilu, která má chuť učit se nové věci a postupně se stát odborníkem v oblasti celní problematiky. Jak vypadá náš pracovní den? Zajišťujeme elektronické celní odbavení importních zásilek. Připravujeme celní dokumentaci, například JSD a tranzitní doklady. Komunikujeme a spolupracujeme s kolegy napříč týmy i v rámci DHL. Pravidelně se potkáváme na společných týmových schůzkách. Pracujeme ve dvousměnném provozu: 6:00–14:15 a 13:45–22:00. Koho hledáme? Máš SŠ vzdělání s maturitou. Umíš pracovat na PC a MS Office ti není cizí. Máš chuť učit se nové věci a rozvíjet se. Český jazyk ovládáš na výborné úrovni – je to podmínkou. Máš alespoň základy angličtiny a chceš se v ní dál zlepšovat. Jsi pečlivý, zodpovědný a dokážeš pracovat samostatně. Umíš fungovat v týmu a máš proaktivní přístup. Jsi otevřený zpětné vazbě. Zkušenost s celní problematikou je výhodou, ale všechno potřebné tě rádi naučíme. Proč právě k nám? Naučíš se žádanou specializaci v oblasti celní problematiky. Podpoříme tě během zaučení i v dalším profesním rozvoji. Budeš součástí stabilní mezinárodní společnosti. Čeká tě fajn tým, kde si lidé pomáhají a sdílejí své zkušenosti. Zakládáme si na férovém přístupu, otevřené komunikaci a dobré atmosféře. Co ti nabídneme? 5 týdnů dovolené + další dny volna podle délky pracovního poměru. 3 dny osobního volna. MultiSport kartu s příspěvkem od firmy. Stravenkový paušál 100 Kč/den. Cafeteria systém. Možnost posouvat se dál díky vzdělávacím programům. Příspěvek 8 000 Kč na jazykový kurz po zkušební době. Penzijní nebo životní pojištění po roce spolupráce. Slevy u našich partnerů – například na telefonní tarify, nákupy nebo cestování. Firemní akce a dobrovolnické projekty. Zaměstnanecké slevy na přepravu zásilek. Zaujala tě nabídka? Pošli nám svůj životopis a dej nám o sobě vědět. Rádi tě poznáme a povíme ti víc o tom, co tě u nás čeká. V inzerátu jsou osoby uváděny v mužském rodě. Tento postup byl zvolen výhradně za účelem dosažení co nejvyšší plynulosti textu. V žádném případě nevyjadřuje genderově podmíněný nebo diskriminační přístup společnosti DHL Express (Czech Republic) s.r.o. k uchazečům a uchazečkám o volná pracovní místa.

new_matches.description: Chceš proniknout do světa cel a mezinárodní logistiky? Staň se součástí našeho importního týmu a rozvíjej se v oboru, který má budoucnost. Aktuálně rozšiřujeme tým celních referentů a hledáme posilu, která má chuť učit se nové věci a postupně se stát odborníkem v oblasti celní problematiky. Jak vypadá náš pracovní den? Zajišťujeme elektronické celní odbavení importních zásilek. Připravujeme celní dokumentaci, například JSD a tranzitní doklady. Komunikujeme a spolupracujeme s kolegy napříč týmy i v rámci DHL. Pravidelně se potkáváme na společných týmových schůzkách. Pracujeme ve dvousměnném provozu: 6:00–14:15 a 13:45–22:00. Koho hledáme? Máš SŠ vzdělání s maturitou. Umíš pracovat na PC a MS Office ti není cizí. Máš chuť učit se nové věci a rozvíjet se. Český jazyk ovládáš na výborné úrovni – je to podmínkou. Máš alespoň základy angličtiny a chceš se v ní dál zlepšovat. Jsi pečlivý, zodpovědný a dokážeš pracovat samostatně. Umíš fungovat v týmu a máš proaktivní přístup. Jsi otevřený zpětné vazbě. Zkušenost s celní problematikou je výhodou, ale všechno potřebné tě rádi naučíme. Proč právě k nám? Naučíš se žádanou specializaci v oblasti celní problematiky. Podpoříme tě během zaučení i v dalším profesním rozvoji. Budeš součástí stabilní mezinárodní společnosti. Čeká tě fajn tým, kde si lidé pomáhají a sdílejí své zkušenosti. Zakládáme si na férovém přístupu, otevřené komunikaci a dobré atmosféře. Co ti nabídneme? 5 týdnů dovolené + další dny volna podle délky pracovního poměru. 3 dny osobního volna. MultiSport kartu s příspěvkem od firmy. Stravenkový paušál 100 Kč/den. Cafeteria systém. Možnost posouvat se dál díky vzdělávacím programům. Příspěvek 8 000 Kč na jazykový kurz po zkušební době. Penzijní nebo životní pojištění po roce spolupráce. Slevy u našich partnerů – například na telefonní tarify, nákupy nebo cestování. Firemní akce a dobrovolnické projekty. Zaměstnanecké slevy na přepravu zásilek. Zaujala tě nabídka? Pošli nám svůj životopis a dej nám o sobě vědět. Rádi tě poznáme a povíme ti víc o tom, co tě u nás čeká. V inzerátu jsou osoby uváděny v mužském rodě. Tento postup byl zvolen výhradně za účelem dosažení co nejvyšší plynulosti textu. V žádném případě nevyjadřuje genderově podmíněný nebo diskriminační přístup společnosti DHL Express (Czech Republic) s.r.o. k uchazečům a uchazečkám o volná pracovní místa.
